featured.description: An interactive estimate builder on Fillip's website where visitors pick packages and add-ons and get their estimate by email.
featured.challenge: Visitors wanted a quick idea of project scope without a long back-and-forth over email before a first conversation.

faqItems.question: How much does it cost to hire a React developer?
faqItems.answer: The cost depends on the developer's experience, the complexity of your frontend, the technologies involved, the engagement model and how long you need the developer. We provide a project-specific estimate once we understand your requirements.

faqItems.question: What type of React developers can I hire?
faqItems.answer: You can hire React Frontend Developers, React + Next.js Developers, React + TypeScript Developers, UI Component Developers, React Dashboard Developers, Full-Stack React Developers, React Performance Specialists and React Migration Developers.

faqItems.question: What technologies do your React developers work with?
faqItems.answer: Our React developers work with React, Next.js, TypeScript and JavaScript; styling and motion tools such as Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion; REST and GraphQL APIs; backends such as Node.js and NestJS; headless CMS platforms such as Strapi, Contentful and Sanity; and hosting on Vercel, Netlify, AWS or Cloudflare.

faqItems.question: Can your React developers work on our existing codebase?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Developers can review your existing React code, follow your conventions and workflow, and add features, fix issues or improve performance alongside your team.
